notes: Correct for both backends, including single-file roots that name the suffixed link and seeks past the end. The NewObject/New fallback logic and the symlink-only EOF special case in zip Open are somewhat convoluted.
Identical to C2: the reference implementation plus docs and solid end-to-end tests, though seek/range options are not tested.

The code matches the reference fix, with a relevant docs section added. Tests cover squashfs links with a regular `.rclonelink` file, zip read-back and the hostile-archive escape, but not range/seek reads.

Adds an unrequested zip pre-scan that silently drops members under symlink paths. This does block the escape, but it diverges from the expected behaviour where the destination refuses the write, and it fails that hidden test; it also adds complexity.

Listing, NewObject, the skip notice and the regular `.rclonelink` file case all work, but pointing the root at `name.rclonelink` fails: squashfs double-suffixes `f.file` and zip adds the suffix after the root comparison. Zip link targets are also read eagerly at mount time, adding I/O and a whole-Fs failure point.
